goals.description: This course prepares Master students with an overview of some of the most relevant physical concepts and theoretical tools in the field of quantum optics. After successful completion of the module the students are able to:1. understand fundamental processes of light-matter interactions at the quantum level and how they can be applied to manipulate quantum states of photons and atoms or for laser cooling techniques. 2. understand the basic theoretical tools for modelling light-matter interactions and open quantum systems in typical quantum optical settings. 3. autonomously apply these concepts and techniques to model and numerically simulate basic light-matter interaction processes in atomic and solid-state systems.
